# Official MLSys template provenance

The [MLSys 2027 call for research papers](https://mlsys.org/Conferences/2027/CallForResearchPapers)
explicitly prescribes the 2025 style archive. Verified 2026-10-12.

Downloaded from the official link:
https://media.mlsys.org/Conferences/MLSYS2025/mlsys2025style.zip

`04e77090038f78c985154c71f7a57b7fbb2553ddd3e4e62f431ed420ba3768ef`

Original attribution/comments are retained. The archive supplies conference
formatting files; no additional license is invented. Its bundled algorithm,
algorithmic, and fancyhdr dependencies are also retained unmodified to avoid
version-specific formatting differences. There is no fabricated
`mlsys2027.sty`, and no formatting override to shrink the manuscript.
